free_tier.stated: The maximum allowed file size is 1024 MiB; uploads are a plain HTTP POST with no account step; files are kept 3 to 100 days depending on size; no total quota is stated on the page.

retention.stated: Retention 3 to 100 days, scaled by file size via MIN_AGE + (MAX_AGE - MIN_AGE) * (1 - size/max_size)^2, so small files live ~100 days and near-max files ~3 days

egress.terms: free direct HTTPS GET from x0.at, no redirect, no metering; Content-Length served correctly and range requests supported.

tooling: plain curl multipart: curl -F file=@x https://x0.at/ (also -F keep_name=1, -F id_length=N). ShareX and Hupl configs published. Open-source server: github.com/Rouji/filehost2 (37 stars). No rclone backend.
chaining: unlimited anonymous uploads at 1 GiB each with random IDs; the only chaining needed is a client-side index of returned URLs. Retention is the binding constraint, not quota.
limits_note: 1024 MiB/file; 3-100 day retention driven by size; no accounts so no listing or bulk delete; deletion only by knowing the URL.

identity_cost.detail: no account: uploads are a plain HTTP POST (curl -F file=@...); the page documents no sign-in step

reliability_note: Longest-lived 0x0 derivative still accepting uploads. Provenance is a hobby VPS; no durability guarantee and expiry is silent and size-dependent. Treat as a 3-8 week cache tier, not archive.
